import copy
from jobs import unique_jobs


def test_stable_dedup_by_source_source_id():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 2, "title": "Job2"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},  # duplicate of first
        {"source": "B", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},  # same title, different source
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3, "Should deduplicate by (source, source_id)"
    assert result[0]["title"] == "Job1" and result[0]["source"] == "A"
    assert result[1]["title"] == "Job2"
    assert result[2]["title"] == "Job1" and result[2]["source"] == "B"


def test_stability_first_occurrence_wins():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 1, "First occurrence should win"
    assert result[0]["source"] == "A"


def test_empty_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": "", "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": "", "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, "Empty source_id should be kept separately"
    assert result[0]["source_id"] == ""
    assert result[1]["source_id"] == 1


def test_none_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": None, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": None, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, "None source_id should be kept separately"
    assert result[0]["source_id"] is None
    assert result[1]["source_id"] == 1


def test_missing_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, "Missing source_id should be kept separately"
    assert result[0]["source_id"] is None
    assert result[1]["source_id"] == 1


def test_no_merge_across_sources():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "B", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "C", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3, "Should not merge across sources"
    sources = [r["source"] for r in result]
    assert sources == ["A", "B", "C"]


def test_no_merge_by_title():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 2, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 3, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 3, "Should not merge by title"


def test_does_not_mutate_input():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    original = copy.deepcopy(rows)
    unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == original, "Should not mutate input"


def test_empty_input():
    result = unique_jobs([])
    assert result == []


def test_single_row():
    rows = [{"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"}]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0]["source"] == "A"
    assert result[0]["source_id"] == 1


def test_mixed_source_id_types():
    rows = [
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
        {"source": "A", "source_id": "1", "title": "Job1"},  # string vs int
        {"source": "A", "source_id": 1, "title": "Job1"},
    ]
    result = unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, "String and int source_id should be treated as different"
    assert result[0]["source_id"] == 1
    assert result[1]["source_id"] == "1"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_stable_dedup_by_source_source_id()
    test_stability_first_occurrence_wins()
    test_empty_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_none_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_missing_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_no_merge_across_sources()
    test_no_merge_by_title()
    test_does_not_mutate_input()
    test_empty_input()
    test_single_row()
    test_mixed_source_id_types()
    print("All tests passed.")
